title: Clubhouse Games: 51 Worldwide Classics
subtitle: A small table for games from around the world
summary: Clubhouse Games: 51 Worldwide Classics is NDcube's collection of board, card and tabletop games, released for Nintendo Switch on 5 June 2020.
body: Clubhouse Games: 51 Worldwide Classics is NDcube's collection of board, card and tabletop games, released for Nintendo Switch on 5 June 2020. Known as 51 Worldwide Games in Europe and Australia, it places familiar pastimes beside games a player may never have encountered. Chess, shogi, mancala and toy sports share a compact presentation. Short explanations introduce their rules before play begins, allowing the collection to move between learning something unfamiliar and returning to a game already understood by everyone around the table.

Computer opponents provide different levels of challenge for solo play, while local and online options turn many of the games into encounters with other people. The rules stay close to the tabletop activity, but the software handles setup, legal moves and scoring. That makes it easier to begin an unfamiliar game without first mastering all its procedures. The toy figures used as guides contribute small pieces of background information, connecting the current match to the histories and traditions represented in the collection.

Some activities use motion controls, and Mosaic Mode can join several Switch screens into a larger playing surface for compatible games such as Slot Cars. The free Guest Pass lets nearby players join a host who owns the full collection. Toshiki Aida composed the music. The appeal comes from the ease of changing the scale and character of the gathering: a quiet strategic match, a quick card game and a small physical contest can follow one another without requiring another box on the table.
